mostWorthwhile.text: Serving the supper was the strongest payoff: the crops survived the storm and became a tangible meal, with a welcome personal message to Earth.

leastWorthwhile.text: Shelling and soaking the beans were sensible but fairly routine, with little decision-making once the compatible options were offered.

surprise.text: Harvesting the potatoes also washed and cut them in one action; I expected preparation might require another step.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly purposeless. The cloth’s use with the pods was initially unclear, but the result explained it as catching the shelled beans.

continue.text: Yes. The meal paid off the growing-room story, and I would be curious to see the specimens’ return unfold, though this chapter’s mostly linear choices offered limited challenge.
